media.title: Georg Jacoby on location in the Netherlands, 1953
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of the film director Georg Jacoby standing outdoors during filming, 1953.
media.publicCaption: Georg Jacoby during the filming of Die geschiedene Frau in the Dutch bulb-growing region, 26 April 1953 — two decades after the work documented here. Jacoby directed Melodie der Liebe (1932), for which Kaper wrote music.
